getMeeting.trackInfo: Inspection 6:30AM 1/6;   1600 chute Heavy 8 Heavy fog this morning visibility to 50M

previousRailPositions.comments: Finalised 15/5 - 7:45am - Rider Rpls R2 N10, R3 N9, R6 N7, R8 N9 & N13 - Late Rider R7 N11

meetTips.longComment: Inside lanes deemed inferior, with jockeys quickly aiming away from the rail. Horses who settled close to the speed were suited and it wasn't easy to make a sustained run from back in the field.

meetTips.shortComment: Incredibly Heavy track - Slow times & hard to make ground.
meetTips.longComment: Hard day to make ground in what was a day of tough slogs up the hill in very slow times suggesting worse side of Heavy9. Forgive horses who got back or struggled.

First half of the card dominated by those on-speed, but times also reflect that they were slowly run events. Last 2 races on the card run at much faster speeds and as a result, winners were able to come from off the pace. Winners in lanes 1-5 at the 400m and 1-15 at the 200m, indicating that the track raced well.

previousRailPositions.comments: Track Upgraded to (Good 4) @ 3:06 PM after Race 3

meetTips.longComment: Winners came from 0-6.7L off the lead at the 800m and in lanes 2-7 at the 200m. However, off pace winners did slice through closer to the fence and those runners covering ground were disadvantaged.
